info.title: ModelShared (Service)
info.description: Data model containing model dependencies of the clients of the current microservice (WebApp, ServiceTest)

ID.description: A UUID identifying a resource, nested object, catalogue definition, option or assignment in a declared ownership and type scope.

X.description: Signed meridian arc length from the equator to a point latitude on the reference ellipsoid; north positive. Physical quantity: PositionDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 Riemannian coordinate convention.

Y.description: Signed arc length along the latitude parallel from the reference meridian to a point longitude; east positive. Physical quantity: PositionDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 Riemannian coordinate convention.

Z.description: Negative ellipsoidal height measured along the ellipsoid normal: positive inward from the reference ellipsoid. Physical quantity: DepthDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

RiemannianNorth.description: Signed meridian arc length from the equator to a point latitude on the reference ellipsoid; north positive. Physical quantity: PositionDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 Riemannian coordinate convention.

RiemannianEast.description: Signed arc length along the latitude parallel from the reference meridian to a point longitude; east positive. Physical quantity: PositionDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 Riemannian coordinate convention.

Latitude.description: Angle between the ellipsoid normal and the equatorial plane; north positive. Physical quantity: PlaneAngleGeodesic; SI unit: radians (rad). Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

Longitude.description: Angular position eastward from the reference meridian. Physical quantity: PlaneAngleGeodesic; SI unit: radians (rad). Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

TVD.description: Negative ellipsoidal height measured along the ellipsoid normal: positive inward from the reference ellipsoid. Physical quantity: DepthDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

ReferencePoint.description: Position specified by geodetic latitude, longitude and ellipsoidal depth. Geographic angles use SI radians; linear coordinates and ellipsoidal depth use SI metres. X/Y are Riemannian north/east arc coordinates, not projected easting/northing. Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

IsInteriorBoundary.description: Boolean declaration that a derived boundary represents the interior side of a closed source delineation line.

constraints: False does not universally mean exterior: open-line offsets also use false.

IsClosed.description: Boolean declaration that a line is geometrically closed according to the provider closure rule.

constraints: Derived geometry is distinct from user-supplied geometry.

Margin.description: Horizontal offset distance used to derive a boundary from a delineation line under a declared geometric algorithm. Physical quantity: LengthStandard; SI unit: metres (m).

constraints: Not a positional coordinate or an uncertainty estimate.
The current Field provider calculates boundaries only for a positive margin; null or nonpositive values produce no boundary.
The provider uses planar operations on Riemannian coordinates; this does not establish a globally exact geodesic buffer.

TopDepth.description: Negative ellipsoidal height measured along the ellipsoid normal: positive inward from the reference ellipsoid. Physical quantity: DepthDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

constraints: Depth = -ellipsoidal height; not a geoid or mean-sea-level depth.
Positions are not additive extents.
A quantity of length does not make depth positions summable.
x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: WGS84 geodetic latitude/longitude with Greenwich origin and ellipsoidal depth positive downward; not a fully specified terrestrial frame realization or epoch.

BottomDepth.description: Negative ellipsoidal height measured along the ellipsoid normal: positive inward from the reference ellipsoid. Physical quantity: DepthDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

constraints: Depth = -ellipsoidal height; not a geoid or mean-sea-level depth.
Positions are not additive extents.
A quantity of length does not make depth positions summable.
x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: WGS84 geodetic latitude/longitude with Greenwich origin and ellipsoidal depth positive downward; not a fully specified terrestrial frame realization or epoch.

constraints: An open line is not a closed area; line type does not by itself establish a legal boundary.
